title: English Practice Quiz 0779
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 01: A municipal corporation generally manages?
options: local civic services in an urban area
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: local civic services in an urban area.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 02: A birth certificate is an official record of?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: a person's birth.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 03: A public grievance system allows citizens to?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: submit complaints about public services.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 04: A voter registration record is used to?
options: establish eligibility to vote in an election
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: establish eligibility to vote in an election.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 05: A public notice communicates?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: information relevant to the community.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 06: A local sanitation service helps?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: maintain public cleanliness and hygiene.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 07: An official government form should be completed with?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: accurate information and required documents.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 08: A public library provides?
options: access to books and learning resources
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: access to books and learning resources.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 09: A civic responsibility includes?
options: following lawful public rules and respecting shared spaces
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: following lawful public rules and respecting shared spaces.

questions.question: Civic Awareness and Public Services 10: A service application reference number helps?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: track the application status.
